purpose: independent evaluation sample preparation only; no instrument pass claim

population.query: all current csat_items joined to csat_exams where organizer=kice and type_id in the two types; no outcome or difficulty filtering

eligibility: nonempty current passage and exact SHA256
single official answer 1..5 independently matched to answer-source evidence
current passage fully covered by baked skeleton ranges and all five markers once in order
source PDF hash and exam form matched to known source anchors
source body and markers compared to the PDF
research read-only access available; no original-content redistribution
not in pilot or a duplicate/near-duplicate of its passages

rightsGate.researchUse: authorized local read-only access only; copyright retained
rightsGate.redistribution: NOT_AUTHORIZED; public artifacts contain identifiers/hashes/status only
rightsGate.noLicenseInference: publicly available and locally possessed are not a license; any unanswered permission issue stays explicit

duplicates.normalization: NFKC, strip the five vocabulary markers, lowercase, normalize whitespace and curly quotes
duplicates.near: set Jaccard similarity of normalized character 5-grams >= 0.80 triggers HOLD_DUPLICATE_REVIEW

ordering.withinCell: ascending hexadecimal score, itemId as final tie-breaker

selection: after all eligibility statuses are finalized, walk cells in fixed order, admit first two eligible distinct passages as primary and next one as reserve; continue ranked list past duplicates/holds; do not substitute across cells
shortfalls: record missing quota and blocking reasons; no silent relaxation, no selecting on future instrument results
freeze: seal these exact bytes before fetching population bodies or choosing IDs; freeze audit and selection separately afterwards; amendments are linked new revisions only
leakage: do not create or transfer any new contextual sense gold, options or cue annotations until the redesigned instrument is frozen; developer receives only public metadata; later unseen reviewers must disclose prior exposure
reporting: no random-sample representativeness or statistical power claim; report counts and exclusions including holds; outcomes are not yet evaluated
